core_obligations: Reduce to the affine local case with constant relative dimension d, and note coherence and the strategy for flatness (proof lines 6015-6025).
Handle d = 0 by the quasi-finite case and d > 0 by factoring through the affine space and applying the affine line computation (proof lines 6027-6040).
proof_roadmap: The cases d = 0 and d > 0 (proof lines 6027-6040).
difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, if f : X -> Y is Cohen-Macaulay in the sense of More on Morphisms, Definition labelled more-morphisms-definition-CM, the lemma asserts that f^!O_Y = omega_{X/Y}[d] for a coherent O_X-module omega_{X/Y} flat over Y, where d is the locally constant relative dimension (statement lines 5977-6013). The proof notes that d is well defined and locally constant by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-flat-finite-presentation-CM-fibres-relative-dimension, that the cohomology sheaves of f^!O_Y are coherent by Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-coherent, and that flatness of omega_{X/Y} will follow from Lemma labelled lemma-flat-shriek once the other cohomology sheaves vanish (proof lines 6015-6025). The question is local, so one may assume X and Y affine and the relative dimension equal to d: for d = 0 the result follows from Lemma labelled lemma-flat-quasi-finite-shriek, and for d > 0 one uses a factorization X -> A^d_Y -> Y with g quasi-finite flat, given by More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-flat-finite-presentation-characterize-CM, so that f^! = g^! o p^! and p^!O_Y = O_{A^d_Y}[-d] by Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-affine-line, reducing to the case d = 0 (proof lines 6027-6040). Reducing the local statement to a factorization through the affine space and then to the quasi-finite case is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
